from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.DEBATE_SOLVER_PROMPT_A, prompt_custom.DEBATE_SOLVER_PROMPT_B, prompt_custom.DEBATE_SOLVER_PROMPT_C, prompt_custom.DEBATE_SOLVER_PROMPT_D], aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.DEBATE_AGG_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        recover = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.COORD_RECOVER_WORKER_A, prompt_custom.COORD_RECOVER_WORKER_B, prompt_custom.COORD_RECOVER_WORKER_C], coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.COORD_RECOVER_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
        solution = await recover(f"Original puzzle:\n{problem}\n\nDebate draft:\n{draft['response']}")
        return solution['response'], {"worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(), "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta()}
